organ_name: AoA Goal Space and operator projection

aoa-agents.owns: role mandate responsibility return and wake semantics
aoa-agents.dashboard_action: observe validated receipts and refs only

aoa-skills.owns: capability ABI and task-local DAG vocabulary

aoa-sdk.owns: workspace discovery typed compatibility control-plane and RunPlan/incarnation seams
aoa-sdk.dashboard_action: consume binding refs; never select or admit them

abyss-stack.owns: runtime source deployment and live lifecycle
abyss-stack.dashboard_action: keep source deploy and live evidence distinct

.aoa-session-memory.owns: raw session material freshness and the bounded Goal catalog publisher
.aoa-session-memory.dashboard_action: admit the exact Goal catalog schema and retain refs provenance and degradation

aoa-stats.dashboard_action: consume derived views without inventing zeros or quality claims

human_operator.owns: semantic acceptance policy and irreversible authority

private_admission.record_policy: do not add a record until a concrete dashboard access contour, source evidence, compatibility, proof, and owner acceptance exist
future_route: dashboard source owner defines the bounded read capability and effect ceiling
aoa-sdk validates and compiles the typed candidate
workspace owner validates the expiring private v2 source and records the contour
abyss-stack supplies deployment or live evidence only when a runtime effect exists
aoa-evals supplies independent proof for any stronger claim
dashboard owner and human operator accept the bounded payload before admission
private_admission.rollback: lower admission to deny or shadow first, revoke the consumer route, preserve the source record and receipt refs, then restore only after revalidation

local: for contract in contracts/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool $contract >/dev/null; done

handoff.next_transition: master filters this return, updates the Goal DAG, and routes any access contour to its natural owner
handoff.claim_limit: source and federation bootstrap landed; task-instance identity is supplied by the explicit return/handoff packet; no private admission, runtime deployment, proof verdict, semantic reentry, or human acceptance is claimed
